summary: Switch remains one active U.S. data-center platform. Direct sources support DigitalBridge/DBP II, IFM/GIF and the management rollover group in the latest 55.8%/37.2%/7.0% same-level schedule, while Aware Super has a continuing but non-additive stake whose exact size, vehicle and close date are not publicly disclosed. InfraBridge is not a direct owner, and neither the reported confidential IPO filing nor the pending SoftBank-DigitalBridge transaction changes Switch's owner periods.
